name: albania-vat
description: Albanian VAT (TVSH, tatimi mbi vlerën e shtuar) for tax year 2026 under Law No. 92/2014 as amended to Law No. 80/2025, Council of Ministers Decision No. 953/2014 and Law No. 87/2019 on invoices and fiscalisation. Covers the 20% standard rate, the 6% and 10% reduced rates and what each covers, 0% exports and international transport, exempt supplies, the ALL 10,000,000 registration threshold, voluntary registration above ALL 5,000,000, notaries and bailiffs at zero threshold, monthly returns due 14 days after the month, reverse charge and self-invoicing on imported services, e-invoicing and fiscalisation, refunds above ALL 400,000, and penalties under Law No. 9920/2008. Trigger on 'Albania VAT', 'TVSH', 'Albanian VAT return', 'VAT registration Albania', 'fiskalizimi', 'reverse charge Albania'. Out of scope: income tax (albania-income-tax, al-corporate-tax), payroll (albania-payroll), social contributions (albania-social-contributions), withholding and treaties (al-cross-border), planning
